source: measured by src/mtgcommander/calibrate.py; each bracket's label says whether it was measured, interpolated or set by judgment
format: per bracket, each role is [min, target, max] cards counted over the 99 cards (98 with two commanders); topend is the most nonland cards with mana value 6 or more
method: Per deck, the 99 cards (98 with two commanders, commanders left out) are counted by role with roles.counts; a list that names each basic land once gets its lands recounted as 100 minus commanders minus nonland cards. Across a bracket's decks, min = 25th percentile, target = median, max = 90th percentile (lands: 10th, median, 90th; topend, the cap on nonland cards of mana value 6 or more: 75th percentile); percentiles interpolate linearly between ranked decks and round half up; counterspells use only decks whose commander has blue. Bracket 2 = 60 MTGJSON Commander precons released 2024-01-22 to 2026-10-02, precons as a Bracket 2 proxy (Wizards no longer ties Core to precons). Bracket 5 = 248 EDHTop16 top-cut decks from the newest 150 entries of each of: Kraum, Ludevic's Opus / Tymna the Weaver (39), Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy (42), Rograkh, Son of Rohgahh / Thrasios, Triton Hero (39), Rograkh, Son of Rohgahh / Silas Renn, Seeker Adept (43), Sisay, Weatherlight Captain (41), Thrasios, Triton Hero / Tymna the Weaver (44). Brackets 3 and 4 = interpolated between 2 and 5, a quarter and half of the way (judgment; no Bracket 3 or 4 deck was sampled). Bracket 1 = Bracket 2 with land target +1 and tutor target 0 (judgment).

labels.1: judgment: Bracket 2 values with land target +1 and tutor target 0
labels.2: measured: 60 recent precons (precons as a Bracket 2 proxy)
labels.3: interpolated (judgment): Bracket 2 plus 1/4 of the way to Bracket 5
labels.4: interpolated (judgment): Bracket 2 plus 1/2 of the way to Bracket 5
